name: SYNDRO_SURV_EVENT_PROBS
description: Contains the problems associated with syndromic surveillance events.

columns.name: SYNDRO_SURV_EVENT_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the syndromic surveillance event record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: PROBLEM_DATE
columns.description: The date of the problem that met the syndrome criteria.

columns.name: PROBLEM_LIST_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the problem (LPL) that met the syndrome criteria.
